body:
It started off as a good day. It was the weekend and a break from school, I had the day to myself. So what better way to enjoy it than getting really messed up. I left my house and head to my friends house with a bottle of gin, a xanax bar,and some great but and some hash oil. When I arrived we started drinking and smoking. We eventually got bored and decided it was a got day to head to the river since it was a nice day. I wasnt too buzzed so I did not think about driving drunk... Big mistake.
[Erowid Note:

Don't do it!
]
We arrived at the river and I popped the bar. We chilled by the river and drank and smoked for a few hours. Then it was time to go I got in the car and drove back to my friend house and got some food and had a few more shots. Then I headed home not knowing how fucked up I was. I drove home fine until I got one street from my house and drove off the road and over corrected sending my car into a out of control skid into a rod iron fence with cement pillars. It happened so fast. Luckly I was not killed , but people came out and called the cops. When the cop arrived he said I smelled like booze and gave me a sobriety test. I did good on all the test except the breath test. I did a have breath and it picked a a trace . So since I was under 21 they took me in for a blood test.  We pulled into a parking lot and I asked the cop is this jail and he said no this is the hospital we need to see if you neck and back are  fine. So when we went in I said my neck hurt and my back. This saved me from going to jail. But they drew my blood and I had a .13. So now I got a dui and totaled my car and my family is not too happy with me.
Now I dont even like to drive or take xanax or even smoke which I used to love because now I just reminds me of my bad decisions I made that day. I got kinda luky though I didn't get hurt and the cop dint look in my car I had almost a zip of dank and an almost emty bottle of gin.  But I'm still fucked.
